title: Some GTA Fans Would Give Up Their Pets to Play GTA 6 Early
description: A recent poll of 1,300 American gamers by IGN Games reveals a concerning trend of fans willing to abandon their pets just to play GTA 6 early.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Unprecedented Hype Surrounding GTA 6

Ever since Rockstar Games first began teasing and outlining the next installment in the legendary franchise, the gaming world has been gripped by an unprecedented wave of anticipation. Every piece of news, every rumor, and every data point regarding Grand Theft Auto VI commands massive attention. Recently, IGN Games highlighted a startling and somewhat concerning metric that underscores just how far some enthusiasts are willing to go for their favorite hobby.

## A Poll of 1,300 American Gamers

According to a poll of 1,300 American gamers covered by IGN Games, a troubling trend has emerged among a portion of the fanbase. When faced with extreme hypothetical scenarios regarding early access to GTA 6, some respondents indicated a willingness to abandon their pets for a chance at playing the game ahead of its official release.

While public opinion polls often incorporate extreme hypothetical choices to gauge overall enthusiasm, the revelation that players would consider sacrificing their real-life animal companions for a video game has sparked widespread discussion across gaming forums and social media platforms.

## Cultural Impact and Obsession

The phenomenon highlights the extraordinary grip that the Grand Theft Auto series holds over contemporary gaming culture. As fans continue to wait anxiously for further updates from Rockstar Games, the boundary between healthy passion and extreme obsession continues to blur for a subset of the community.

## Editor's Take

While polls like this often lean into sensationalism and hyperbole, it's a fascinating—and slightly alarming—look at modern gamer culture. Video games are an incredible medium, but nothing in the virtual world should ever replace the real-life responsibility and love we owe to our pets.
